title: See America Travel Poster
coreRelationships: Large, dark red-brown rock formations with natural arches dominate the upper and mid-ground, framing a lighter blue sky.
A lighter, sandy-yellow ground plane extends from the foreground into the mid-ground, contrasting with the darker rock.
Small, stylized green-blue bushes and trees are scattered across the mid-ground and foreground, providing visual texture and scale.
Two small figures on horseback are positioned in the lower-left mid-ground, providing a sense of human presence and scale against the vast landscape.
The bottom section features bold, sans-serif text 'SEE AMERICA' in a light blue-grey, with smaller text below it.
reuseFormula: Generate a vintage travel poster in the WPA style, featuring a prominent natural rock arch as the main subject. Use a limited palette of 5-7 flat, un-gradated colors, including a dominant earthy red/brown for the rock, a sandy yellow for the ground, and a clear blue for the sky. Include small, stylized green-blue vegetation and tiny figures (e.g., on horseback) to establish scale. The composition should be bold and graphic, with strong visual separation between color blocks. Place a large, sans-serif title at the bottom.
